theater: 河北道冀州城（今河北寧晉）

battle.name: 竇建德攻佔冀州之戰
battle.theater: 河北道冀州城（今河北寧晉）
battle.brief: 武德元年（618）冬，竇建德自樂壽出兵，圍隋朝冀州城（今河北寧晉）：砲車壓制城頭，撞車撞門，雲梯蟻附，十月築壘，十一月城破，州治與所屬諸縣盡歸夏國。卡面的羅馬投石機未到過冀州，它的功能對應者是夏軍拆牆壓制的砲車。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 攻方是竇建德在河北組成的武裝。竇建德原是洺州觀津的農民，隋末大業年間河北饑荒中散家財、聚鄉人起事，先併吞同郡渠帥高士達的部眾，據樂壽為基地，武德元年受洛陽方面的隋越王楊侗授為冀王，隨後僭稱夏王、國號夏，以樂壽為都。他並非隋朝正式編制內的州郡長史，而是自置文武官屬、以尚書令一類職銜總理民政的割據政權；旗下則是清河、渤海、洺州、趙州一帶的郡縣吏員、鄉里渠帥，以及陸續歸附的河北義軍，兵眾以步卒為主，另有產於河北的健馬組成的騎兵，糧秣靠河北平原的屯墾與徵發維持。守方是仍以隋朝名義立州的冀州官署與州兵，刺史以下一班隋朝舊臣憑城固守，名義上奉的是正在崩解的隋室：江都的隋煬帝在武德元年四月為宇文化及所弒，洛陽則落在王世充與越王楊侗手中，河北各州於是多數仍用隋的年號與官名，實則各自為守。第三方是關中新建的唐朝：李淵建唐之後在河北道用兵，派將往援冀州，兵糧線由黎陽、滑州一線維持，同時招撫幽州總管羅藝，令河北形成唐、夏、隋三面互相牽制的局面。
countriesEn: The attacking side was the armed force Dou Jiande had assembled in Hebei. Dou was a peasant from Guanjin in Mingzhou; during the famines of the last years of the Daye era he gave away his family property, gathered villagers and rose, first swallowing up the bands of the local strongman Gao Shida, then making Leshou his base. In the first year of Wude he was invested as Prince of Ji by the Sui Prince of Yue Yang Tong at Luoyang, and he soon proclaimed himself King of Xia, with the state of Xia and Leshou as his capital. He was no prefect appointed through Sui channels but a separatist power that set up its own civil and military officials, with offices such as the director of state affairs handling civil administration. Under him served commandery and county officials from Qinghe, Bohai, Mingzhou and Zhaozhou, village strongmen, and the Hebei insurgents who came over one by one. His army was foot soldiers for the most part, with cavalry on the hardy horses of the Hebei plain, and his supplies came from the crops and levies of that plain. The defending side was the Jizhou administration and its local troops, which still bore the name of the Sui and were led by the provincial governor and a group of Sui officials holding the city. Nominally they served a collapsing house: Emperor Yang of Sui had been killed at Jiangdu by Yuwen Huaji in the fourth month of the first year of Wude, while at Luoyang the Prince of Yue Yang Tong was in the hands of Wang Shichong; the prefectures of Hebei therefore kept Sui era names and Sui titles while in practice each defended itself. The third party was the new Tang, founded in Guanzhong by Li Yuan, which opened a front in Hebei, sent a general to relieve Jizhou, kept its line of supply and grain through Liyang and Huazhou, and at the same time won over the Youzhou commander Luo Yi, so that Hebei was pinned from three sides between Tang, Xia and the surviving Sui.
people: 竇建德（字伏國）是貫穿全場的唯一人物。他出身河北觀津的農戶，大業末年河北饑荒，他散家財、聚鄉人起事，最初與河北各路渠帥如高士達、張金稱各自聚兵，後來以突襲併吞高士達之眾，人數驟增，才有了經營河北的本錢。他用兵一向借「大義」立名，與瓦崗軍的李密往來通書，與幽州總管羅藝先攻後和，把河北中部與北部都抓在手上；武德元年受封冀王之後，他自稱夏王，國號夏，以樂壽為都，設官屬、置倉儲，出兵攻城都帶著僭越的名分。攻城前線的河北將領中，王行敏是舊史常提的一個，他替竇建德出擊河北各郡，也曾被派去與唐軍周旋，後來歸唐，繼續在河北一帶作戰。守方沒有留下戰死者的姓名，只留下「隋朝舊臣據守冀州」這樣一條行政記錄，這本身說明城中的抵抗來自一套官僚體系，而不是一支有名字的軍隊。外部的關鍵人物是唐高祖李淵與秦王李世民：前者派兵往河北、封羅藝以牽制竇建德，後者則在關中對劉武周作戰，同時以洛陽方向與河北相呼應。唐廷這一手，使竇建德無法專注攻城，也預先為他布下了後患。
peopleEn: Dou Jiande, courtesy name Fuguo, is the one man who runs through the whole affair. He was born a peasant in Guanjin in Hebei; in the famines at the end of the Daye era he gave away his property, gathered the villagers and rose, at first raising a separate band alongside men such as Gao Shida and Zhang Jincheng of the same commandery, and then taking Gao Shida's followers by surprise, which multiplied his numbers and gave him the means to hold Hebei. He always fought under some banner of righteousness, corresponded with Li Mi of the Wagang, fought and then made terms with Luo Yi of Youzhou, and so held both central and northern Hebei in his grasp. After he was invested as Prince of Ji in the first year of Wude he proclaimed himself King of Xia, with the state of Xia and Leshou as his capital, setting up officials and storehouses, and every campaign and siege he fought was carried under a usurped title. Among the Hebei commanders in the siege line, Wang Xingmin is the one the old histories often name: he struck at the prefectures of Hebei for Dou Jiande, was sent to operate against Tang troops, and later surrendered to Tang and went on to fight in the Hebei area. The defenders left no names of the fallen, only an administrative record to the effect that Sui officials held Jizhou, which in itself shows that the resistance inside the walls came from a bureaucratic apparatus rather than from a named army. The decisive figures outside are Tang Gaozu Li Yuan and the Prince of Qin Li Shimin: the former sent troops into Hebei and invested Luo Yi in order to pin Dou Jiande down, while the latter was fighting Liu Wuzhou in Guanzhong and kept the link with Hebei through the direction of Luoyang. That move by the Tang court kept Dou Jiande from concentrating on the siege, and it laid up a future trouble for him as well.
kits: 卡面這件投石機是羅馬的單臂扭力投射機，西元前三世紀中葉已經出現：木架上以扭緊的皮筋與繩索蓄力，臂端繫兜，把石彈甩出，用於攻城時拆毀城牆與塔樓，羅馬共和國晚期自第一次布匿戰爭之後，它成了圍城的標準裝備。它本身並沒有出現在冀州城下，中文文獻從未記錄任何羅馬攻城器械隨夏軍到來；它在這場戰役裡的對應物，是唐與河北義軍通用的「砲」，即以木架、槓桿與繩索絞盤驅動、把石彈拋向城頭的投石車，唐初的兵書對砲的形制、操作人數、射程與石彈重量都有記載。與砲配套的還有撞車、雲梯、巢車、鉤援與飛火：撞車推向城門與城牆基部連日撞擊，雲梯貼牆而上，巢車用以觀察城中並射擊，鉤援攀援城頭，飛火則是帶火的箭矢與炭火，用來燒灼城頭的布帛與器材，只是此時火藥仍屬新物，並未成為攻城的主幹手段。人員裝備方面，夏軍步卒執長矛、槊與環首刀，著緣甲或明光甲，攻城時以大楯護身、穴地掘進；守方憑城頭弓弩、落石、拒馬與女牆居高臨下。河北是產馬之地，夏軍的騎兵與運糧車隊是圍城戰力的另一半。
kitsEn: The catapult on this card is the Roman single-arm torsion engine, already in existence by the middle of the third century BC: twisted sinew and rope on a timber frame store the power, a sling is fastened to the end of the arm, and a stone shot is flung out to smash walls and towers during a siege; in the late Roman Republic, from the First Punic War onward, it was standard equipment for besieging a city. The machine itself never stood before the walls of Jizhou, and no Chinese text records any Roman siege engine coming to Hebei with Dou Jiande's army. Its counterpart in this battle was the crossbow-armed stone thrower the Tang and the Hebei insurgents both used, the pao: a timber frame with a beam and a rope winch that hurled stone shot at the ramparts, and the early Tang military books describe its form, the number of men needed to work it, its range and the weight of its shot. Working with the pao were the battering ram, the scaling ladder, the observation turret, the hook ladder and the fire arrows: the ram was pushed up against gates and the foot of the wall to pound for days, the ladder lay against the wall, the turret was used to see into the city and to shoot from it, the hook ladder was hauled up the face, and the fire arrows and charcoal were meant to burn the cloth and the equipment on the wall, though gunpowder was still a novelty at that date and played no leading part in the siege. On the personal side, Dou's foot soldiers carried long spears, the mao and ring-pommel swords, wearing rimmed or Mingguang armour, and they protected themselves with large shields and dug in under cover when assaulting; the defenders replied from the ramparts with bows and crossbows, stones dropped from above, cheval-de-frise and parapets. Hebei was a horse-breeding country, so Dou's cavalry and his baggage trains made up the other half of his siege force.
tactics: 攻城與野戰在這場戰役裡是兩件事。竇建德以大軍壓住冀州城的三面，只留一面通達；同時切斷城內的糧道與消息，往來道路由游騎封鎖，城內只能靠存糧與井水支撐。圍壘之外，他分兵一部監視幽州方向的羅藝與唐軍的援線，確保攻城時側翼不受牽制。攻城器械分三處使用：砲車置於城外遠處的陣地，壓制城頭弓弩手與女牆；撞車推向城門與城牆基部，連日撞擊；雲梯與鉤援靠近牆根，等砲火造成缺口或守軍疲憊時蟻附而上。守方的對應是死守不出、以弓弩與落石反制、搶修缺口，並在城內挖地道以反制對方的穴地掘進，同時向洛陽與唐朝求援。援兵一度接近城下，竇建德以主力連夜出擊，援軍在城外被擊潰，城中的抵抗隨之瓦解。城破之後，他做的第一件事是接管州府、清點府庫、收編降卒與歸順的郡縣，把這座城變成他向河北腹地與中原挺進的支點，軍隊隨即轉向黎陽、滑州一線的糧倉與漕運。
tacticsEn: In this campaign the siege and the field battle were two separate things. Dou Jiande pressed the city of Jizhou on three sides and left only one open, and at the same time cut the grain route and the news of the city: the roads in and out were sealed by his mounted patrols, so that inside the walls only stored grain and well water remained to sustain the garrison. Outside the cordon he detached a part of his force to watch Luo Yi in Youzhou and the Tang relief line, so that his flank could not be turned while he was at the walls. He used his siege machines in three ways: the stone throwers stood in a battery far enough out to cover the rampart with its missile troops and parapets, the battering rams were pushed up to the gates and the foot of the wall to pound day after day, and the scaling and hook ladders were brought to the foot of the wall so that they could be mounted once the stone fire had opened a breach or the defenders were worn out. The defenders answered by refusing to leave the walls, replying with bows, crossbows and stones dropped from above, hurrying up the breaches, and digging counter-tunnels inside the city against the attackers' saps; they also appealed for help to Luoyang and to the Tang. Relief troops did approach the city, and Dou took his main force out by night and struck them, breaking them outside the walls, after which resistance inside collapsed. Once the city fell, his first acts were to take over the administration, count the stores, take the surrendered troops and the localities that came over into his own service, and turn the city into a base for pushing into the heart of Hebei and into the Central Plain; the army then swung toward the granaries and the transport line of Liyang and Huazhou.
data: 可核的數字並不多，以下幾個大致有據。竇建德在河北起家時的部眾，舊史記載已達數萬之眾，到武德五年與唐軍在板渚相遇時，他號令的兵眾以十餘萬計，兩相比照，可見河北根據地在他手上擴張的速度。冀州是河北大州之一，《隋書·地理志》記冀州領縣十餘、戶口逾十萬，州城即治所冀縣，在今河北邢臺寧晉一帶，城牆周圍數里。樂壽在河北獻縣，自樂壽至冀縣的道路約三百里，竇建德由據點出兵距離不遠，但河北春秋兩季道路泥濘，車隊與攻城器械的輸送遠慢於步騎，這也是他每次出兵都要先算糧期的緣故。攻城一端，唐初的砲車每發可拋石數十斤，射程以數百步計，築在城外二百步之內便可覆蓋城頭一段；石彈不必要求精確命中女牆，只要令守軍不能抬頭便已足夠。圍城歷時一月有餘；舊史只把此事繫在武德元年之冬，具體月份依推記定在十月築壘、十一月城破，而數十日的糧秣消耗正是守方無法久撐的主因，而竇建德用以維持圍城軍隊的，正是他從樂壽與河北各州徵集的糧食與牲畜。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and the following are broadly founded. Dou Jiande's following when he rose in Hebei is recorded in the old histories as several tens of thousands of men; by the time he met Tang troops at Ban Zhu in the fifth year of Wude he was ordering around more than a hundred thousand, and the comparison shows how fast his Hebei base grew. Jizhou was one of the great prefectures of Hebei. The Book of Sui, in its geography chapter, records that Jizhou governed a dozen or more counties with a population over one hundred thousand, and that the prefectural city was the seat of Jizhou county, in the Ningjin area of Xingtai in modern Hebei, with walls running several li around. Leshou lies in Xian county in modern Hebei, and the road from Leshou to Jizhou county runs about three hundred li. Dou's march from his base was therefore short, but the Hebei roads in spring and autumn are mud, and wagons and siege engines travel far more slowly than foot soldiers and horses, which is why he always had to count the rations before he marched. On the siege side, the Tang-era stone thrower sent a shot of several tens of jin each time with a range of several hundred paces, and once emplaced within two hundred paces of the wall it could cover a stretch of rampart; the shot did not need to strike the parapet exactly, it was enough that the defenders could not raise their heads. The blockade lasted a month or more: the old histories only tie the affair to the winter of the first year of Wude, and the precise months, the raising of the works in the tenth and the fall of the city in the eleventh, are a reconstruction; what is certain is that the consumption of supplies over those tens of days was what the defenders could not outlast; what kept Dou's investing army supplied was the grain and the draught animals he levied at Leshou and across the prefectures of Hebei.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是隋朝崩解留下的真空：大業末年河北連年水旱饑荒，租調照徵、官吏又苛，百姓流亡，河北一時群雄並起，竇建德不過是其中收兵最多、占地最廣的一支。他起事本無大義名分，靠吞併同郡渠帥起家，愈打愈強，反過來要隋朝承認他，於是遣使到洛陽，請楊侗封他為冀王；江都的隋煬帝在武德元年四月為宇文化及所弒，隋室名分斷裂，河北各州既不能指望江都，也不能完全服從洛陽，便各自依附更強的鄰州，冀州正是這樣被捲入。第二層是竇建德的戰略選擇：他先攻幽州，與羅藝相持不下，轉而南下取冀州，既取得州城與倉廩，又切斷唐軍在河北的北方支點，等於在唐廷與河北之間楔進一枚釘子。第三層是唐廷的反制：李淵在關中建唐，必須把河北的道、州收回版圖，於是派兵往援冀州、招撫羅藝、經營黎陽；竇建德若退守樂壽，河北的道州仍會被陸續拉走，所以他必須在唐兵到齊之前把冀州拿下。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause behind the fighting. The first was the void left by the collapse of the Sui: in the last years of the Daye era Hebei suffered flood and drought in succession, the taxes were levied as before, the officials grew harsher, and the people fled and turned to banditry, so that a dozen rival powers rose in Hebei at once, and Dou Jiande was only the one of them who gathered the most men and held the most ground. He began with no banner of great righteousness, built himself by swallowing up the strongmen who had risen in Hebei, and the stronger he grew the more he needed the Sui to acknowledge him, so he sent envoys to Luoyang and asked Yang Tong to make him Prince of Ji. Then Emperor Yang of Sui was killed at Jiangdu by Yuwen Huaji in the fourth month of the first year of Wude and the Sui name was broken in two; the prefectures of Hebei could no longer look to Jiangdu nor obey Luoyang completely, so each attached itself to whichever neighbour was stronger, and Jizhou was drawn in this way. The second layer was Dou's own strategic choice: he struck at Youzhou first, could not settle the matter with Luo Yi there, and turned south to take Jizhou instead, gaining a prefectural city and its granaries while cutting the northern anchor of the Tang presence in Hebei, driving a wedge between the Tang court and the plain. The third layer was the Tang counterstroke: Li Yuan, having founded the Tang in Guanzhong, had to bring the circuits and prefectures of Hebei back under his own authority, so he sent a general to relieve Jizhou, won over Luo Yi and built up Liyang. Had Dou Jiande fallen back on Leshou, the prefectures of Hebei would still have been pulled away one by one, so he had to take Jizhou before Tang troops could assemble.
impact: 冀州落入竇建德之手，是隋末唐初北方格局的一個關鍵轉折。河北是隋代最富的區域之一，冀州城、府庫、倉廩與州兵一併易手，等於給了竇建德一座真正的州城與一整套地方行政，而不是只有部眾與野地；他在河北中部有了據點，得以同時對洛陽的王世充與關中的唐廷施加壓力，往後他與李密、宇文化及、王世充之間的合縱連橫，都以冀州為後盾。其二，唐朝在河北的經營被迫提前，武德初年河北道的州縣不是被說服、而是被打下來，河北此後數年反覆易主，反映出隋末唐初地方割據軍閥成片的慣例。第三，竇建德的勝利也讓他的部眾膨脹，騎兵與攻城器械大量增加，卻沒有相應的編制與攻城制度；這支靠兼併起家、來源雜亂的軍隊愈壯大，戰鬥力愈難集中，這一點在三年後的板渚之戰會付出代價。第四，冀州易主使河北中部出現一條明確的敵我分界，隋朝在河北的殘餘政權加速瓦解，隋末以來長達十年的分裂戰爭，至此由收拾隋室轉為唐與地方割據勢力爭奪河北。
impactEn: The fall of Jizhou into Dou Jiande's hands was a decisive turn in the northern pattern of the late Sui and early Tang. Hebei was one of the richest regions of the Sui, and the city, the treasury, the granaries and the local troops all changed hands together, which gave Dou a real prefectural city and a complete local administration instead of nothing but a following and open country. With a base in central Hebei he could press both Wang Shichong at Luoyang and the Tang court in Guanzhong at once, and every later combination and manoeuvre between him, Li Mi, Yuwen Huaji and Wang Shichong had Jizhou behind it. Second, the Tang presence in Hebei was forced forward: in the opening years of Wude the prefectures of Hebei were not won over but taken, and the repeated change of hands across the region in the years that followed shows how thoroughly the late Sui and early Tang were given over to local military magnates. Third, the victory inflated Dou's following: cavalry and siege engines multiplied, but no matching organisation or siege system came with them, and the larger this conglomerate of conquered bands grew the harder it was to concentrate its fighting power, a weakness it would pay for at Ban Zhu three years later. Fourth, the loss of Jizhou drew a clear line between the two sides in central Hebei, accelerated the disappearance of the last Sui authorities in the north, and turned a decade of civil war that had begun as the liquidation of the Sui house into a Tang struggle against the regional separatist powers for the possession of Hebei.
result: 結果是冀州城在武德元年十一月落入竇建德之手，州治冀縣與所屬諸縣一併歸附，他留下官吏收編降卒，把城中的府庫、兵械與糧食納入自己的軍資，隨即把兵鋒轉向黎陽、滑州方向的糧倉與漕運線，河北中部的局面就此翻轉。守方沒有等到援軍，援軍在城外被夜襲擊潰，城中的隋朝舊臣或降或散，隋朝在河北最後幾個據點之一就這樣消失。竇建德因此在河北取得壓倒性的優勢，一度兵鋒直抵河南，與唐軍在洛陽、黎陽一線對峙。但勝利也埋下隱患：部眾來自河北各處渠帥，器械雖多而編制不整，攻城所得的州縣靠羈縻而非制度整合；當他日後以十餘萬眾南下救援洛陽、在板渚與李世民的騎兵相遇時，這支靠吞併起家的軍隊暴露了整編與機動的弱點，最終兵潰被擒，冀州這場攻城戰的勝利，成了他一生最後一場大敗的伏筆。
resultEn: In the end the city of Jizhou fell to Dou Jiande in the eleventh month of the first year of Wude. The seat at Jizhou county and the counties belonging to it came over with it; he left officials behind, took the surrendered troops into his service, and folded the treasury, the arms and the grain of the city into his own war supplies. He then turned his army toward the granaries and the transport line of Liyang and Huazhou, and the situation in central Hebei was reversed. The defenders never received their relief, the relief was broken outside the walls by a night attack, and the Sui officials inside either surrendered or scattered, so that one of the last Sui strongholds in Hebei simply disappeared. Dou Jiande gained a decisive advantage in Hebei, carried the war south to the edge of Henan, and stood facing the Tang army along the Luoyang and Liyang lines. Yet the victory carried its own weakness: his men came from every Hebei strongman, his machines were many but his organisation uneven, and the prefectures he had taken were held by appointment and concession rather than by any settled institution. When he later marched south with more than a hundred thousand men to relieve Luoyang and met Li Shimin's cavalry at Ban Zhu, this army of absorbed bands showed how poorly it could be ordered and how badly it could move, and it broke and was taken. The victory at Jizhou thus became the set-up for the last great defeat of his life.
